error.title: Output Module
error.description:
## Output Module is not valid
Composition '{comp_name}' cannot be rendered with its current Render Queue Output Module.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Click **Repair** to write the output file name of the preset, then **refresh** the publisher (circular arrow button).
If the problem persists, or there is no Output Module at all, do it by hand: open `Window > Render Queue`, select the item of the composition, open `Output Module` and pick one of the allowed presets: {allowed}
The output file name is built from the product name '{product_name}'.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__ (optional)
Format, codec, file name and frame numbering of the Render Queue item are compared with the presets configured in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.
Frame sequences need AE's `[#####]` token, not a printf pattern such as `%05d`.
Repair only writes the Output Modules that fail, and only their file name: format and codec can be changed only through an Output Module template, so a preset without one leaves them to you.

error.title: Output file name
error.description:
## Output file name does not match the product name
Output Module {index} of '{comp_name}' writes '{actual}', but the product is '{product_name}'.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Click **Repair** to rename the output to '{product_name}', then **refresh** the publisher (circular arrow button).
Or rename the file in the Render Queue `Output To` field, or change the file name pattern of the preset in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.

error.title: Output extension
error.description:
## Output extension is not allowed
Output Module {index} writes '{actual}', expected {expected}.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Change the format in the Output Module, or add the extension to the preset in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.
**Repair** cannot rename the extension on its own: the format decides what After Effects writes, so it is only written when the preset has an Output Module template.

error.title: Frame numbering
error.description:
## Frame numbering does not match the format
Output Module {index} writes '{actual}'.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Click **Repair** to rewrite the name with the configured frame token and padding, then **refresh** the publisher (circular arrow button).
Or use a `[#####]` token in the file name for frame sequences, and a plain name for single file formats. Or change the preset in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.

error.title: Output format
error.description:
## Output format is not allowed
Output Module {index} uses '{actual}'.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Pick one of the allowed presets: {allowed}
Or add the format to `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.
**Repair** can only switch the format when the preset has an Output Module template; without one, set it in the Output Module by hand.
